title: The Me I Want Them to See

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Snap!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: …So, how does it looky-look?
choice_data_list: Well, it turned out like this…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Pffft. What's up with my face?! I look super serious!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ines Fujin came to me saying that she wants to send her family a photo of herself wearing her signature racewear, so I'm helping her take the picture.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Hmm. It is a funny picture, though! Still, that's not quite what I'm looking for…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Sorry, can we go again? They've been asking to see a photo, so I'd like to make it a good one…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, thankies! Okay, for the next one…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Let's try this!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Or maybe… this!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: And if that doesn't work… get a load of this!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Hmm… We've snapped a bunch of pictures, but none of them are clicking with me…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We browse through all the photos together, but I have to agree…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Yeah… So we want a shot of me in my signature racewear, right? One that says, "Look, I'm really running!"

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Dad, Mom, my sisters… It's thanks to their support that I'm here.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: When they saw how much I loved running, they cheered me on every step of the way… So the thing I really want to show them would be…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: That's it! I've got it! Trainer, let's go to the track!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Get ready, Trainer, I'm going to run at my very best! My family gave me the push I needed to sprint towards my dreams—and that's what I want to show them!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: No retakes. We've got one shot here, so make it perfect! I'm counting on you!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Okay, it's in your hands!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Rrraaahhh!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ines Fujin shoots down the track as if she's racing for real. Though I briefly fumble with the camera, I quickly lock my eyes on to her figure and take the shot.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Snap!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant… Phew! Did you get a good one?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fully confident, I show her the picture I took…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Oh… Ahaha!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It shows Ines Fujin running as passionately as she does in real races, and with sharp eyes locked straight ahead. She looks cool, and is clearly enjoying the moment.
choice_data_list: Now this is how you were meant to flaunt that racewear!
Now this is how you were meant to flaunt that racewear!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Yeah… That's what was missing! What an awesome photo!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Thanks for all your help with this! Hehe. Okay, time to send this to my folks!
choice_data_list: We really got the perfect shot!
We really got the perfect shot!
Why not send all the photos we took?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Why not send all the photos we took?
choice_data_list: We really got the perfect shot!
We really got the perfect shot!
Why not send all the photos we took?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Yeah! I just know they'll love it! Aaand… send.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Okay, now to get changed and train!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: …Wow, my mom's already replied! Let's see…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: "Thanks for the photo! It's a relief to see you all energized and having so much fun."

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: "Your sisters love how cool you look. They've even made this photo their lock screen." Nice!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: …I guess you really are the best at capturing me in the moment, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ines Fujin is absolutely thrilled. It looks like this signature racewear photo shoot has been a great experience!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: What?! We can't! There are a few weird ones in there!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Like, there's one where… See, look! I'm making a heart with my hands in this one, and I've got this smug face here! And there are others, too!
choice_data_list: None of them are as bad as you say…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: They are bad! I have a "dependable older sister" image to maintain, you know…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Okay, this stuff's staying between us, Trainer! I've got to sort these into folders later.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: And now to get changed for training! I've got to work hard if I want to look cool in real races, too!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ines Fujin dashes off confidently. As she does, I think about how I'll need to keep supporting her so she can continue to run in style.
